chunks: He said: Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Babawayh — may Allah have mercy on him — informed me, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Walid narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab narrated to us, from 'Ali ibn Asbat, from 'Ali ibn Hamzah, from Abu Basir, from Abu 'Abdillah Ja'far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon them both, who said:

Allah, Most High, revealed to 'Isa son of Maryam, peace be upon him: "O 'Isa, give Me tears from your eyes and humility from your heart. Line your eyes with the kohl-stick of sorrow when the idle ones laugh. Stand by the graves of the dead and call out to them in a loud voice — perhaps you will take your lesson from them. And say: 'Indeed, I shall join them among those who follow.'"
May Allah bless our master Muhammad and his pure progeny.

key_terms.الدُّمُوع: Tears — a sign of spiritual tenderness and fear of Allah
key_terms.اللَّاحِقِين: Those who follow/join — refers to all mortals who inevitably follow the dead
key_terms.الْبَطَّالُون: The idle ones — those who waste their time in heedless amusement
key_terms.الْخُشُوع: Humility/Khushu‘ — deep reverence and submissiveness before God
key_terms.مَوْعِظَة: Admonition/lesson — moral instruction drawn from reflection
key_terms.مِيل الْحُزْن: The kohl-stick of sorrow — a metaphor for adorning the eyes with grief rather than cosmetics

ai.seo_question: What did Allah reveal to Prophet Isa (Jesus) about weeping, humility, and visiting graves?
ai.summary: In this hadith, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) relates a divine revelation (wahy) from Allah to Prophet ‘Isa ibn Maryam (Jesus, peace be upon him), commanding him to weep, show humility, and reflect upon death by visiting graves. The exhortation contrasts the heedless laughter of the idle with the sober contemplation of mortality, urging ‘Isa to draw admonition from the deceased and acknowledge his own inevitable death. This type of divine counsel to earlier prophets was commonly cited in Shi‘a tradition to emphasize universal ethical principles — particularly humility, sorrow for the hereafter, and remembrance of death.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 7. He said: Abu Ja’far Muhammad ibn ‘Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Babawayh - may Allah bless him with mercy, reported to me from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Walid, who reported from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, who reported from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abu al-Khattab, from ‘Ali ibn Asbat, from ‘Ali ibn Hamzah, from Abu Basir, that: Abu Abdillah Ja’far ibn Muhmmad, peace be upon him, said:

Allah, Most High, revealed to Isa son of Maryam, peace be upon them both: "O Isa, give me tears from your eyes, humility from your heart and line your eyes with the kohl of sorrow, while the idle waste away their days laughing; stand by the graveside and call them loudly, perchance you may thus learn from their fate. And then say: Surely, I will soon be joining them, together with the other joners."
And may Allah bless His Prophet, our master Muhammad and his pure progeny.
